notes: Normal article content heights are the primary target; errors are only404/SEO regression.
All entries initially use content-fit half53.52dvh; manual native up drag allows a near-full ceiling with49px reserved at top.
Fixtures include short, medium and very long summaries plus real-map groups1/2/12.
At a low viewport height or with related reports, equal capped default heights are expected.
User-expanded mode has an explicit near-full height; trailing empty space is intentional for short content, while the gap before sharing must stay normal.
No product observer/state/SDK overrides; only actual UI actions and DOM geometry reads.
Clipboard/share failures are synthetic browser capabilities only in the manual-URL scenario.
The existing full product gate is reported separately and is not included in these check counts.
